subject: GSI integration routemap & demo slot — next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@orbitgsi.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next step: tech deep-dive and calendar windows

Hi Sandeep —

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. Quick recap from our side: OrbitGSI is evaluating a partner-hosted integration to surface Redwood inference in your managed marketplace offering. Primary goals you flagged: predictable latency for burst inference, private VPC routing for enterprise tenants, and a partner-managed onboarding flow for new resellers.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep-dive focused on integration touchpoints (auth, routing, failover), expected throughput, and an owner-level handoff. Suggested attendees: your platform lead + solutions architect, our runtime engineer (Jonas), and our partner ops lead (Marcus).

Please pick any 1-hour slot from the grid attached (calendar_grid.ics). For convenience we can do either:
- Tue Aug 10 between 10:00–13:00 PDT / 13:00–16:00 EDT
- Wed Aug 11 between 09:00–12:00 PDT / 12:00–15:00 EDT

If those don't work, share your availability and we'll adapt. Attaching a 1-page proposed integration routemap and a short proposal outline so your procurement folks have context ahead of the call.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: integration_routemap.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet), proposal_outline.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), calendar_grid.ics

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@orbitgsi.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Schultz <lena.schultz@cloudjunction.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step: tech deep-dive and calendar windows

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Lena (cc'd) is our platform lead and will join. Wed Aug 11 looks better for us but we have a hard block 10:30–11:15 PDT. Can we target 11:30–12:30 PDT on Wed? If Jonas can cover runtime/kernel questions that's perfect.

A couple of asks before the call so our infra team can prep:
- A short list of expected peak RPS per tenant and total concurrent KV cache size (ballpark numbers are fine).
- Any non-standard firewall/KMS ports that require ops change.

We'll aim to have our solutions architect (Lena) and a PM there. Confirming Lena's email is lena.schultz@cloudjunction.com.

Thanks — Sandeep
Head of Partnerships, OrbitGSI
sandeep.rao@orbitgsi.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Perfect — wed 11:30–12:30 PDT (Thu 19:30–20:30 CEST for EU attendees) is locked from our side. I've attached a short pre-read and the routemap (integration_routemap.xlsx) to the calendar invite; I'll send the invite once Jonas confirms he can cover the kernel/latency discussion.

Jonas — can you confirm you'll take the runtime deep-dive and have the ballpark numbers Sandeep requested? If we can also include a short slide on our automatic batching and prefix/KV caching behavior that will help the architecture discussion.

Next steps captured:
- Vanessa to send calendar invite + pre-read (done after Jonas confirms)
- Jonas to prepare peak RPS and KV cache rough numbers
- Marcus to prepare partner onboarding checklist and point-of-contact for reseller ops

— V

Subject: Re: Quick recap + next step: tech deep-dive and calendar windows

Vanessa / Sandeep —

I can take the runtime deep-dive next Wed at 11:30 PDT. Ballpark numbers (will bring more precise telemetry to the meeting):
- Expected peak per-tenant RPS (initial pilot): 10–50 requests/sec per tenant depending on prompt length; aggregate pilot across 20 tenants ~ 400 RPS peak.
- KV cache sizing: 2–6 GB per active shard depending on model context length and number of concurrent sessions.
- No non-standard firewall ports required for outbound calls; we recommend opening secure egress to the Redwood endpoint range and allowing TLS 443. KMS integrations use standard TLS; if you require HSM-specific network paths we can coordinate.

Marcus: I put a short draft of the partner onboarding checklist in the shared Drive link (see invite). Marcus, can you add the operational owner names and SLA expectations?

See you both Wed — I'll include a short 3-slide primer on batching behavior and cache eviction heuristics.

— Jonas
Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
